note.p: Chapter-level note that is not section text.

section.heading: Validity, irrevocability, and enforcement of agreements to arbitrate

content.p: A written provision in any maritime transaction to settle by arbitration a controversy shall be valid, irrevocable, and enforceable, save as otherwise provided in chapter 4.

note.heading: Amendments
note.p: 2022—Pub. L. 117–90 inserted “or as otherwise provided in chapter 4”.

section.content: A quoted section inside a note is not an article.

chapter.heading: ARBITRATION OF DISPUTES INVOLVING SEXUAL ASSAULT AND SEXUAL HARASSMENT

paragraph.heading: Predispute arbitration agreement.—
paragraph.content: The term “predispute arbitration agreement” means any agreement to arbitrate a dispute that had not yet arisen.

paragraph.heading: Sexual assault dispute.—
paragraph.content: The term “sexual assault dispute” means a dispute involving a nonconsensual sexual act as defined in section 2246 of title 18.

subsection.heading: In general
subsection.chapeau: Notwithstanding any other provision of this title—

paragraph.content: no predispute arbitration agreement shall be valid; and
no predispute joint-action waiver shall be valid,

subsection.continuation: with respect to a case under section 401.

subsection.heading: Determination of applicability
subsection.content: An issue as to whether this chapter applies shall be determined by a court.
